title: RBNZ October OCR: separate media conference
facts: RBNZ confirms an online media conference at 3:00 PM New Zealand time, one hour after its October 28 OCR publication.
time_note: October 28, 9:00 AM Jakarta; the existing broker decision is a distinct stage at 8:00 AM.
interpretation: NZDCHF short reassessment: this Q&A is a separate stage one hour after the decision. Guidance implying faster or more persistent tightening than contemporaneous expectations could strengthen NZD and challenge/invalidate the short's policy premise; a more patient path could support it. A hike alone is not enough to establish the surprise. Recheck CHF haven demand and current expectations.
